name: sourceline-workspace
description: SourceLine turns AI answers and documents into claim-by-claim evidence reports.

scripts.check: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm -r --sort typecheck
scripts.release:check: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.tmp-pack',{recursive:true})" && corepack pnpm run release:verify-manifests && corepack pnpm run check && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm --filter sourceline pack --pack-destination .tmp-pack && corepack pnpm run release:verify-tarball
